title: Volkswagen Supervisory Board Approves Restructuring Eliminating 50,000 Jobs
detail: Volkswagen's supervisory board approved a major restructuring plan eliminating 50,000 positions — the largest workforce reduction in the German automaker's history — with significant ripple effects expected across the EU economy, including France's automotive supply chain.

media.caption: Volkswagen supervisory board approves 50,000-job restructuring plan
